slides.label: Townscript alternatives
slides.title: Unifesto vs Townscript, *honestly.*
slides.lede: Which one fits a college club or fest, as of 30 Oct 2026.

slides.title: Your team
slides.text:
*Townscript: an organiser account.*

Unifesto: a Space with Curator, Co-Curator and Crew roles per event.

slides.title: Team events
slides.text:
*Every member, not just the lead.*

Unifesto: the lead pays once, each member claims a seat, answers their own questions and gets a pass.

slides.title: Hackathons
slides.text:
*Not listed on Townscript.*

Unifesto Sprint: teams, rounds, judging and a help desk (Pro).

slides.title: Where Townscript wins
slides.text: Many currencies. A widget for your own website. No app for attendees. A lower listed fee: 2% + 2% gateway. *We'll say it first.*

slides.title: The fees
slides.text:
Townscript: 2% + 2% gateway (domestic), excl. taxes.

Unifesto: buyers pay a 5% processing fee. You keep 100% of the ticket price.

*Free events: no fee on either. As of 30 Oct 2026.*

slides.title: Running a club? *Try a Space.*
slides.lede: Free for RSVP events. Full comparison on our blog.
